target: both Pro variants are in the committed price table, or spec 018 refuses the new default outright
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/common.sh" 2>/dev/null; for m in openai/gpt-5.6-sol-pro openai/gpt-5.6-sol-pro:batch gpt-5.6-sol-pro; do if preflight_price "$m" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "haveprice<$m>"; else echo "nolisting<$m>"; fi; done
_note: Markers are 'haveprice'/'nolisting', NOT 'priced'/'UNPRICED': must_find runs grep -qiF, which is case-insensitive, so 'UNPRICED <id>' satisfies a needle of 'priced <id>' and the case passes on exactly the failure it exists to catch. This is the second time that trap has been hit in this repo; neither marker is a substring of the other under any case folding.
